analogy.rationale: The annotated targets (PDK1/PDPK1, CDK2, CHEK1, GSK3B, KDR) indicate this class is dominated by kinase inhibitors rather than metabolic PDK inhibition, so the closest transcriptional analogs are other kinase-inhibitor classes; however, since these cells are not dependent on the specific pathways and the drugs act on kinases with limited downstream transcriptional footprint at 6-24 h, the expected response is weak.
